searchText: Nice catch! Thanks! <@!199561711278227457> Can you please update to the correct port for websocket? thanks, <@!474451342094499868> but the new command didn't work. I get error: failed to run custom build command for `mdbx-sys v0.11.1` Caused by: process didn't exit successfully: `/home/t730/lighthouse/target/release/build/mdbx-sys-b45cf768acee4f3d/build-script-build` (exit status: 101) --- stderr thread 'main' panicked at 'Unable to find libclang: "couldn't find any valid shared libraries matching: ['libclang.so', 'libclang-*.so', 'libclang.so.*', 'libclang-*.so.*'], set the `LIBCLANG_PATH` environment variable to a path where one of these files can be found (invalid: [])"', /home/t730/.cargo/registry/src/github.com-1ecc6299db9ec823/bindgen-0.59.2/src/lib.rs:2144:31 note: run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace warning: build failed, waiting for other jobs to finish... error: build failed <@!612776905380200459> for the help, what is the command to fix this? Sorry, newb here, just trying to do my part even though I can't troubleshoot without hand holding. can you please execute this command `sudo apt install -y git gcc g++ make cmake pkg-config llvm-dev libclang-dev clang` these are the lighthouse dependencies, i think your guide is missing those. seamonkeys problem is not applicable to you (you are building lighthouse, the problem was with nimbus). Thanks, will give it a go. BTW, is there a better guide that I should follow that's more complete? Thanks I think it's the most noob friendly guide we have so far. If something is missing or is unclear just tell<@!102952036382830592> so he can improve the guide 🙂 Thank you, this works. excerpts.content: can you please execute this command `sudo apt install -y git gcc g++ make cmake pkg-config llvm-dev libclang-dev clang` these are the lighthouse dependencies, i think your guide is missing those. seamonkeys problem is not applicable to you (you are building lighthouse, the problem was with nimbus).
